name: Honeycomb
description: Honeycomb's hosted server runs queries over your events and traces and reads boards and SLOs.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (ui.honeycomb.io) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
